lines.en: Footsteps drag in the cold wind

lines.zh: 冰封的大地下缓缓前行
lines.en: Slowly moves under the frozen earth

lines.zh: 冰晶碎裂，每一步都发出声响
lines.en: Ice crystals break with each step

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，冰块摩擦作响
lines.en: Slow movement, ice blocks rubbing together
Cracked ice breaks beneath the feet

lines.zh: 寒气弥漫，每一步都寒冷

lines.en: Every step crunches through a layer of frost.
Chunks of ice peel off my body.
Frozen Flesh gazes into the distance

lines.zh: 冰封的双眼凝视着黑暗
lines.en: Frozen eyes gaze into the darkness

lines.zh: 冰冷的眼神中透露着警惕

lines.en: Stands quietly, like an ice sculpture

lines.zh: 静止的身躯散发出寒意

lines.en: Frozen body in the cold wind
Gazes at the faint light in the darkness
Something pulses under my ice shell.
I'm thinking of the taste of mint candy.
I wait for the snow to grow deeper.
Gaze like a knife, locking onto the target
Fists clench in the frozen hands
Gaze like a torch in the cold wind
The eyes inside my ice turn to you.

lines.zh: 你呼出的热气暴露了你。
lines.en: Your warm breath gives you away.
The snow you step on is too loud.
I'm watching to see if you freeze.
There isn't a fleck of frost on you.
You're too close to my ice layer.
I'm counting how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 你的火把让我很不舒服。
血液冻结在我的血管里。
你靠近了，冰霜包裹着我的猎物。
lines.en: You approach, frost clings to my prey.

lines.zh: 你的热量让我感到不适。
lines.en: Your warmth is bothersome to me.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则你会结冰。
别动，你会成为我的冻肉。
lines.en: Don't move, you'll be my frozen flesh.
My touch is cold and deadly.

lines.zh: 我只需要冰冻你的灵魂。
lines.en: I just need to freeze your soul.

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，我会抓住你。
lines.en: You're too close, I'll grab you.

lines.zh: 感受寒冰带来的痛苦吧。
lines.en: Feel the pain of the ice.

lines.zh: 我会用你的力量对抗你。
lines.en: I'll use your strength against you.

lines.zh: 小心，我的冰晶会割伤你。
lines.en: Be careful, my ice shards cut.
Don't touch me, you'll regret it.
My ice spears will pierce you.

lines.zh: 用你的力量，给我更多冰。
lines.en: Use your strength, give me more ice.

lines.zh: 你撞不破我的寒冰外壳。
lines.en: You can't break my icy shell.

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，一起生存。

lines.en: In the cold, we keep each other warm.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，一起面对危险。
寒冷是我们的生命之源。
与我同类，共享这片寒地。
lines.en: Be with my kind, share this cold land.
In ice, we find each other.
In the cold, we rely on each other.
In ice, we move forward together.

lines.zh: 冰层下蠕动着一股寒流。
lines.en: A chill moves beneath the ice.
Mint fills the air around you.

lines.zh: 冰冻血肉在你脚下颤抖。
lines.en: Frozen Flesh trembles beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你踏破了它的冰封巢穴。
寒冷的味道在你口中弥漫。

lines.en: You pick up a fragment of ice.
Its corpse hides in the ice.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸在空气中凝结。
lines.en: Its breath condenses in the air.

lines.zh: 寒气从它身上散发出来。
你听到了它轻微的嘶嘶声。

lines.en: Its shadow appears on the ice.
The ice cracks, revealing its head.
A heat source, right over there.
The ice cracks open; I'm out.
My blood has frozen into grit.
A shivering shape in the distance.

lines.zh: 你的身体开始冰凉起来。
冻肉里的眼睛一齐转过来。
lines.en: The eyes in the frozen flesh all turn at once.

lines.zh: 你周围的空气开始结霜。
lines.en: The air around you begins to frost.
Its body is covered in frost.
Frost crawls along the ground toward you.
An icicle aims at your chest.
Every breath you take is colder.
I pounce at the count of three.
White mist is closing in around you.

lines.zh: 冰霜覆盖的身躯劈向你！
冰冷之息刺穿你的皮肤！
寒冰碎片溅射在你周围！
致命的寒意冻结你的血液！
你听见冰层破裂的声音！
lines.en: You hear the sound of ice cracking!

lines.zh: 寒冰碎片击中你的身体！
冰冻血肉的利爪撕裂你的皮肤！
冰霜冻结你的每一次呼吸！
lines.en: Frost freezes every breath of yours!
My ice claws rake your arm!
This fist comes down with frost!
Ice shards spray into your face!

lines.zh: 薄荷味的寒气灌进你嘴里！
冰冻血肉在寒风中苏醒！
lines.en: Frozen Flesh awakens in the cold wind!

lines.zh: 雪地里传来诡异的嘶吼！
lines.en: Strange howls echo in the snow!

lines.zh: 冰层下潜伏着未知的危险！
冰冻血肉从冰封的洞穴中出现！
lines.en: Frozen Flesh emerges from the icy cave!

lines.zh: 雪中闪烁着诡异的光芒！
lines.en: Strange light flickers in the snow!

lines.zh: 寒冷中传来阴森的低语！
冰晶中裂开了一道缝隙！
lines.en: A crack appears in the ice!

lines.zh: 冰霜覆盖的洞穴里露出一双眼睛！
lines.en: A pair of eyes appear in the frost-covered cave!

lines.zh: 冰雪中隐现模糊的影子！
lines.en: Fuzzy shadows emerge from the snow!

lines.zh: 寒风中隐约听到低沉的吼声！
lines.en: Low growls are faintly heard in the cold wind!
An ice shell heaves up under the snow.
Deep in the cave, the ice splits.
A cold mint scent drifts over.

lines.zh: 寒风送来一个模糊的轮廓。
lines.en: The cold wind brings a vague silhouette.
New frost flowers bloom on the ground.

lines.zh: 它从冰层的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out through a crack in the ice.
Footsteps sound on the frozen soil.
One more shape on the ice field.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击撕裂我的皮肤。
